quizName: DMV Practice Test #3 25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: How can you reduce fatigue while riding?
questions.explanation: Rest breaks help reduce fatigue on long trips. Caffeine can be harmful because you may become very tired when it wears off. Dress warmly and protect yourself from wind and rain to prevent fatigue.

questions.question: When a crash happens, a rider wearing a helmet is:

options.text: Less likely to survive than a person not wearing a helmet.
Just as likely to survive as a person not wearing a helmet.
More likely to survive than a person not wearing a helmet.

questions.correctAnswerText: More likely to survive than a person not wearing a helmet.
questions.explanation: Riders without helmets are three times more likely to die from head injuries during a crash than riders who wear helmets.

questions.question: What is the best way to handle a tailgater?
questions.explanation: Let tailgaters pass you. Speeding up only makes them tailgate you at a higher speed, which is more dangerous.

questions.question: Your motorcycle weaves over rain grooves or bridge gratings. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to cross the surface faster.
Weave side to side to get other drivers' attention.
Keep a steady speed and ride straight across.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep a steady speed and ride straight across.
questions.explanation: Keep a steady speed and go straight across grooves or gratings. Trying to correct the weave by zigzagging is more dangerous.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what should riders do?

options.text: Follow each other as closely as possible.
Not worry about distances between members.

questions.explanation: Use a staggered formation when riding in a group. This allows riders to stay close while keeping safe distances between each other.

questions.question: When riding, where should you focus your attention?

options.text: Only on what is in front of you.
Only on what is behind you.
On both what is in front and behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: On both what is in front and behind you.
questions.explanation: Watch the road ahead, but also check your mirrors often to see what is behind you.

questions.question: Should you wear gloves while riding?

options.text: Yes. They keep your hands warm while riding.
Yes. They improve your grip and protect your hands.
No. Gloves can interfere with the controls.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes. They improve your grip and protect your hands.
questions.explanation: Gloves improve your grip and protect your hands. Use full-fingered gloves made of durable material.

questions.question: What removes alcohol from a person's system?
questions.explanation: Only time allows your body to remove alcohol. Nothing can speed up this process.

questions.question: Traffic moving in the same direction is separated by:
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. Solid white lines mean no passing. Dashed white lines mean you can pass if it is safe.

questions.question: When a motorcyclist needs to stop quickly, they should:

options.text: Apply both brakes at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Apply both brakes at the same time.
questions.explanation: Use both brakes at the same time for quick stops. Look ahead to avoid sudden stops.

questions.question: When entering a turn, what should you do with gears?

options.text: Take the motorcycle out of gear.

questions.explanation: Change gears before you enter a turn. If you must change gears while turning, do it smoothly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols or letters. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the right lane will end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They show traffic laws for that area. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols or letters. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: When slowing or stopping a motorcycle, you should:
questions.explanation: Shift down through the gears as you slow or stop. Stay in first gear while stopped so you can move quickly if needed.

questions.question: When buying a motorcycle helmet, what should matter most?
questions.explanation: Protection is the most important thing when choosing a helmet.

questions.question: When traveling at night, is it easy to judge distances?

options.text: Yes, it is easier than during the day.
About the same as during the day.
No, it is harder than during the day.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, it is harder than during the day.
questions.explanation: It is harder to judge distances at night than during the day. Shadows and light help you see how far away objects are. At night, artificial lights may distort or hide these helpful clues.

questions.question: As your motorcycle goes faster, you will:

options.text: Need to shift up through the gears.
Need to shift down through the gears.
Need to put the motorcycle into neutral.

questions.correctAnswerText: Need to shift up through the gears.
questions.explanation: Shift into higher gears as your motorcycle speeds up.

questions.question: Does a passenger need to wear a helmet?

options.text: Only if the rider is wearing one.

questions.explanation: In Virginia, both motorcycle riders and passengers must wear helmets. A helmet is the best protection for your head and neck if you have an accident.

questions.question: How should you use the front brake?
questions.explanation: Always use both brakes together when you slow down or stop.

questions.question: When you borrow a motorcycle, what should you do?

options.text: Assume all controls are in the same place as on your motorcycle.
Take it on the highway right away.
Learn how it works in a safe area first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Learn how it works in a safe area first.
questions.explanation: Every motorcycle is different. Before riding a new motorcycle, learn where all the controls are. Practice riding it in a safe area before going on the road.

questions.question: How can you become sober after drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: Time is the only way to become sober. Your body needs time to remove the alcohol. Nothing else can speed up this process.

questions.question: What is the best footwear for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather boots protect your feet the best while riding. Boots should be high and strong enough to cover and support your ankles.

questions.question: Choose a lane position that:

options.text: Puts you right next to another vehicle.

questions.explanation: Pick a lane position that helps you avoid hazards on the road. Always keep safe space around your motorcycle.

questions.question: What colors should motorcycle riders wear to be most visible?
questions.explanation: Bright orange, red, yellow, and green colors help other drivers see motorcycle riders. Wear these colors for better visibility on the road.
